text:
elaine: Quick sync — after last week's infra hiccup we need to finalize what actually ships in the launch slice. We have two weeks to lock. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ravi: Is this the same cutlist we reviewed on Tuesday or do we re-prioritize based on the new customer asks?

mike: New asks = SAML + audit logs. Both are large. Can we scope a pilot for SAML instead of full tenant SSO?

jamie: +1 on pilot. If we do a SAML pilot we can defer org-level migrations to v1. That frees ~3 sprint points.

angela: UX work for SAML pilot still needs a decision on accepting partial user flow. I can trim screens to just auth + onboard.

elaine: Proposed shaping: keep Core API, Auth (email + SAML-pilot), Basic Console (read-only telemetry), Embeddings infra (minimum), remove: RBAC, full promptstore, advanced billing UI.

sam: sounds reasonable. Can we write quick acceptance criteria for the SAML pilot so QA + security sign off?

elaine: Good call. Draft criteria: ```
- SAML pilot handles IdP-initiated login for a single org
- Session tokens obey existing TTLs
- Audit events emitted for login and token issuance
- No admin-facing org migration tooling in this slice
```

ravi: Also add: fallback to email auth for users if SAML fails. Don't block login.

elaine: added. Also planning note: this cut reduces scope estimate from ~13 -> ~9 story points, which keeps the milestone intact unless infra slip grows.

mike: Ops question — we still need to ship KV cache changes for embeddings to avoid token spikes. Is that in the 9-point plan?

elaine: yes, minimal KV cache + monitoring (not full auto-tuner).

jamie: Customer comms: we'll describe this as "SAML pilot + core inference" and call out RBAC and admin tools as v1 work. Helps set expectations.

angela: I'll make a 1-pager and sample copy for the pilot announcement.

release-bot: Reminder: Feature freeze in 10 business days. Please tag all launch-slice PRs with `launch/slice-1`.

sam: Action items: 
- angela: 1-pager + announcement copy (due EOD Wed)
- jamie: customer-facing FAQ draft (Thu)
- ravi: finalize SAML acceptance + test plan (Thu)
- mike: KV cache minimal implementation plan (Mon)
- elaine: update milestone document and notify sales (today)

elaine: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD I'll lock the cutlist and update the milestone timeline. :white_check_mark:

mike: No objections from infra.

ravi: Security ack pending test plan but alignment LGTM.

jamie: 👍

angela: 👍 will post draft later today.

sam: locking in my side too.
